purpose: Empty orbital drydock background for a separately rendered, interchangeable 3D ship model.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable opaque 16:9 landscape background plate for an orbital shipyard's live 3D ship construction viewer in Stellar Syndicates.
Primary request: a close-up view from WITHIN an EMPTY ORBITAL SHIPYARD assembly berth, generic enough for the game to render any selected real 3D spacecraft over the center. No spacecraft or ship-specific parts are baked into the image.

Input image 1 is the orbital shipyard architecture and style reference. Preserve its heavy pale gray steel portal-shaped gantries, long parallel graphite truss rails, amber work lights, yellow crane machinery, restrained cyan service indicators, and utilitarian station modules. Expand this design into an immersive close-up background. Do not just show the entire exterior station as a small object.

Composition and camera: wide full-bleed landscape 16:9, elevated three-quarter inspection viewpoint from a service platform near the front end, looking diagonally along the EMPTY construction berth into deep space. A clearly recognizable open-air zero-gravity orbital drydock, with distant sparse stars visible through the open sides and open berth. Bring the large structural frames, utility modules, and rail-mounted machinery close enough to see their materials and engineering. Place the long support rails and service catwalks at the lower outer edges, sturdy gantry uprights on the far sides, and overhead crane beams near the top border. Keep perspective consistent and believable.

CRITICAL COMPOSITING REQUIREMENT: the central 65 percent of image width and middle 65 percent of image height must form a broad, quiet, completely EMPTY volume for the actual ship model, with generous clearance for different hull widths, heights, and lengths. The player will later see an interceptor, freighter or larger ship rendered in this same area. Keep central background mostly dark neutral space with only sparse subdued stars. No bright nebula, dramatic galaxy or large planet dominating the center. No solid floor spanning the central opening: this is an exposed orbital construction cradle in vacuum, not a terrestrial hangar. Keep any rear crossbeam low and distant. No foreground structure, diagonal bracing, hanging hoist, arm, scaffold, cable or rail crossing through the future ship silhouette.

Machinery: folded yellow assembly arms parked alongside the outer rail carriages, cranes fully retracted at the top/sides, tool cabinets, utility conduits, small floodlights, a few peripheral solar panels or radiator panels. All machinery stays out of the central placement volume. No active welding, exhaust, smoke or sparks without a ship present.

Style and lighting: polished semi-realistic science-fiction game environment art matching the supplied orbital yard, convincing large industrial geometry with selective fine detail, weathered slate and pale gray steel, dark recessed trusses, yellow machinery, warm amber work lamps, small cyan indicators. Neutral cool space illumination gives readable structure with warm task lighting directed into the empty berth. Restrained highlights, clear silhouettes, no heavy bloom. Strong material continuity with the existing planetary Shipyard II background, while unmistakably in space.

Constraints: one finished environment image only, no ship, no vessel, no cockpit, no engine, no hull skeleton, no suspended hull panel, no cargo pod, no ship-shaped shadow, no crew, no people, no astronauts, no UI, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no progress bars, no placement guides, no placeholder outline, no transparency, no ground terrain, no indoor walls enclosing the berth. The entire asset is a reusable empty background for a separately rendered 3D model.
